identity.resolvedIdentity: The living glassworks institution and central production, museum and visitor complex at Jevnaker, distinct from one retail building, the public park alone or an assumed Glasshytta building centroid.
identity.identityProblem: The site contains production, museum, park, shops, dining and visitor functions. Glasshytta is the functional production core, but no stable separate building geometry was captured. A park object alone is too narrow and a guessed workshop centroid would be unsupported.
identity.splitReason: One canonical institutional point can represent the coherent central complex while production-core and park objects remain contextual components.
